questions.question: Problem 14: Calculate the standard atmosphere values of T, p, and ρ at a geopotential altitude of 14 km.
questions.explanation:
Given: Calculate the standard atmosphere values of T, p, and ρ at a geopotential altitude of 14 km.

Formula: Standard-atmosphere relations: in an isothermal layer p2/p1 = exp[-g*delta_h/(R*T)]; in a lapse-rate layer T = T0-L*h and p/p0 = (T/T0)^[g/(R*L)]. Density follows from rho = p/(R*T), and pressure variation follows dp/dh = -rho*g.

Solution: Convert the supplied quantities to a consistent unit system, substitute them into the formula above, and solve for the requested quantity. For multiple requested parts, repeat the calculation for each part. This gives 216.66 K, 1.41 × 10^4 N/m², 0.23 kg/m³.
